The workspace includes provided box-damage photos and a carrier doorstep image, and the customer wants a replacement for one item plus goodwill consideration because she is a top-tier member. Reference entity IDs: customer id, order id #. MANDATORY steps: 1. authenticate Amara Okafor and confirm the active loyalty-tiered account, 2. inspect the delivered order and determine which item is eligible for exchange based on the supplied damage evidence and order contents, 3. calculate the financial effect of the exchange request and determine whether any additional goodwill credit is justified under policy, 4. submit the post-delivery exchange for the damaged item and, only if supported, issue a separate goodwill store credit, then summarize both outcomes.
